purpose: Create or update documentation that helps a reader act correctly.
positive_examples: document how to run local CI
add a how-to for rotating keys
work_loop: identify the reader and action the doc must support
choose how-to, explanation, or reference format
update validation when docs are required by contract
run proof commands and read the output
done_when: the doc supports a concrete reader action
the doc is in the right information shape
failure_modes: doc restates obvious commands without intent
fallback_policy: If audience or desired action is unclear, choose the most operational interpretation and record it.
